ns1:item.ns1:title: Beyond data quality: Understanding uncertainty in big geodata
ns1:item.dc:title: Beyond data quality: Understanding uncertainty in big geodata
ns1:item.dc:creator: Yihong Yuan Yongmei Lu Yanjia Cao Hongchao Fan a Department of Geography and Environmental Studies, Texas State University, San Marcos, TX, USAb Department of Geography, The University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, Chinac Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Trondheim, NorwayYihong Yuan is a Professor in the Department of Geography and Environmental Studies at Texas State University. Her research interests include spatial-temporal data mining, travel behavior modeling, machine learning, and geocomputation.Yongmei Lu is a Professor in the Department of Geography and Environmental Studies and Associate Dean of Research in the College of Liberal Arts at Texas State University. Her research interests include GIScience and the application of GIS, spatial analysis, and modeling in health research and crime studies.Yanjia Cao is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Geography at the University of Hong Kong. Her research interests include health geography, GIScience, and spatial data science.Hongchao Fan is a Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering, Norwegian University of Science and Technology. His research interests include 3D city modeling (digital twins), laser scanning, photogrammetry, and spatial data mining using crowdsourcing data.

ns1:item.ns1:title: SAGE-Loop: a plug-and-play semantic evolution framework for enhancing neural reconstruction from crowdsourced street view videos
ns1:item.dc:title: SAGE-Loop: a plug-and-play semantic evolution framework for enhancing neural reconstruction from crowdsourced street view videos
ns1:item.dc:creator:
Mengchen Xie Jun Li Yatong Zhou Anran Yang a School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Hebei University of Technology, Tianjin, Chinab Universal Intelligent Sensing Innovation Center, Tianjin Institute of Advanced Technology, Tianjin, Chinac College of Electronic Science and Technology, National University of Defense Technology, Changsha, Hunan, ChinaMengchen Xie is currently pursuing the Ph.D. degree in Electronic Science and Technology with the School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Hebei University of Technology, Tianjin, China. His research interests primarily focus on 3D urban reconstruction from crowdsourced data, neural rendering (e.g., NeRF and 3DGS), and geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI). Jun Li received the Ph.D. degree in Information and Communication Engineering from the National University of Defense Technology, China, in 2000. He currently serves as a Professor with the National University of Defense Technology. His principal research interests encompass the management and analytics of big data, alongside the development and application of spatial information systems. Yatong Zhou received the Ph.D. degree in Information and Communication Engineering from Xi’an Jiaotong University, China, in 2006. He worked previously with the Bureau of Geophysical Prospecting (BGP), CNPC, and the Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, as a Postdoctoral Fellow. He has visiting experiences at Peking University, and The University of Texas at Austin. He is currently a Professor with the Hebei University of Technology. His research mainly focuses on machine learning, intelligent unmanned system, and machine vision.
Anran Yang earned the B.S. degree in Geographical Information Science from Peking University in 2010, followed by the Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering from the National University of Defense Technology in 2016. He is currently an Associate Professor at the College of Electronic Science and Technology, National University of Defense Technology. His research focuses on GeoAI, Volunteered Geographical Information (VGI), and GIS infrastructures.
